messages:
deploy-bot: Preparing blue->green traffic shift for `inference-api` at 2026-03-21T16:10:00Z. Default plan: 1% / 5% / 20% / 60% / 100% over 1m/4m/8m/12m/15m. Rollback on: 5xx rate > 1% OR p99 > 500ms OR queue depth > 200. Operator: @alex. Docs: https://rwd/ops/router-shifts

alex: quick note: new quant profile (Q4) included. GPUs still cold in us-west-2; recommend header-sampled 1% start and pin `/admin` & `/metrics` to v1 for 1h.

priya: agree on pins. I'll add a routing rule: `match: prefix /admin -> inference-api:v1` and `match: header x-canary=1 -> inference-api:v2 weight 1%`.

tom: suggest synthetic user flow to run every 30s against v2 canary. I'll spin up the canary runner now.

sre-ops: monitoring hooks set. Alerts: canary-p95>350ms, infra-cpu>90, qdepth>150. Watching #infra-alerts.

deploy-bot: Preflight result: certs ok, healthchecks green, config diff looks fine. Starting in 2m unless aborted.

alex: start when ready. keep step dwell minimal if canary stable.

deploy-bot: Shift started at 1761245780: applied 1% sampled via header x-canary. Traffic snapshot: 1% v2 / 99% v1. Canary checks: 1m hold.

priya: canary p95 210ms, no errors. proceeding to 5%.

deploy-bot: weight update: 5% -> v2 at 1761245850. Hold 4m.

sre-ops: saw a small p99 blip to 480ms in apac region after the 5% bump. error-rate still 0.2%. pausing advance and reducing to 3% globally to stabilize.

alex: pausing acknowledged. set weights to 3% and hold. tom, keep canary runner running and collect full traces for the blip window.

tom: collecting traces now. suspects: mismatch in pooling config causing warm-restart of workers. snippet from logs:
```
WARN pool: worker_restart reason=pool-resize duration_ms=1200
```

priya: I can flip a runtime flag to increase pool-min to avoid restarts. Safe to apply to us-apac only?

sre-ops: do it in staging-first. If staging looks stable, mirror to apac-prod.

deploy-bot: applied 3% at 1761245900. Holding. Staging patch queued.

release-manager: documenting decision: slowed cadence due to regional p99 spike; applied temporary global 3% to prevent further stress. Will add note to postmortem if we had to roll back.

alex: after pool-min bump in staging, no worker restarts and p99 stayed under 300ms. priya, please roll apac flip in 2m. If good, we'll follow new cadence: 3% -> 12% -> 35% -> 80% -> 100% with 8m holds.

priya: rolling apac now (flip at 1761245990). also extending KV warm TTL by 15s in apac.

sre-ops: apac p99 falling to 260ms after flips, error-rate 0.15%. recommend proceeding to 12% in next window.

tom: canary traces attached to the build: https://rwd/ci/trace/1761245/canary-run. main cause annotated.

deploy-bot: proceeding per adjusted cadence. next weight update scheduled per hold windows. I will post final completion once at 100% and stable for 30m.

release-manager: please keep this thread open until completion. remember to include the pool-min and KV TTL tweaks in release notes (why we paused and how we mitigated). thanks team.
